THE TETRIS BLOCK IS YOUR TIMER
A Tetris block falls on the right. If it hits the bottom — the exploit fires.
Fix the code on the left before it lands.
① STEP 1 — FIND Tap the vulnerable line of code → block snaps to the correct column
② STEP 2 — FIX Tap the correct Snyk fix → block rotates and locks into place ✓
⌨️ Keyboard: press ↑ ↓ to move between choices and Enter to pick — for both finding the vuln and choosing the fix.
Complete both steps before the block lands. Board fills over rounds — just like real Tetris.
